product_metadata.title: Nice Dream Yellow Macrame Leaf Wall Hanging, Boho Wall Decor Handmade Macrame Wall Hanging with Wood Beads Ornaments for Nursery Bedroom Decoration
features: MACRAME LEAF - DO NOT REMOVE BACK FILM! There is a PROTECTIVE FILM on the BACK of LEAF to maintain its shape. If macrame leaf was messed up in transit, please use a comb to brush threads to keep its shape.
BOHO WALL DECOR - Decorate your bedroom, living room, nursery, office or anywhere where you'd like to bring some bohemian elements. The boho wall hanging instantly adds hobo ambiance to your rooms.
HANDMADE MACRAME HANGING - The macrame decor is handmade by quality cotton threads and wood beads. It will always be a focus piece in your home.
PROPER SIZE - Length is 11.8". Width is 7.9". This macrame leaf wall hanging is suitable for baby nursery and bedroom decoration.
PERFECT GIFT - It is an ideal gift for your families or friends who are interested in bohemian art. You will get many compliments with this gorgeous gift.
